proof_body:
by
  intro f a x n hf
  have e := taylor_integral_remainder hf
  rw [taylor_within_apply] at e
  have hs : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), iteratedDerivWithin k f (Set.uIcc a x) a / (k.factorial : ℝ) * (x - a) ^ k = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((k.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹ * (x - a) ^ k) • iteratedDerivWithin k f (Set.uIcc a x) a := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hi : ∫ t in a..x, (x - t) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) * iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f (Set.uIcc a x) t = ∫ t in a..x, ((x - t) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) • iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f (Set.uIcc a x) t := by
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun t _ => ?_
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hs, hi, ← e]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a x : ℝ) (n : ℕ), ContDiffOn ℝ (n + 1 : ℕ) f (Set.uIcc a x) → f x = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), iteratedDerivWithin k f (Set.uIcc a x) a / (k.factorial : ℝ) * (x - a) ^ k + ∫ t in a..x, (x - t) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) * iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f (Set.uIcc a x) t
